ideas.title: Gifts for the Ham in Your Life: Picks From Icom, Xiegu, Heil and Stocking Stuffers Under $40
ideas.why_now: Thanksgiving week is when families start asking what to buy their ham. A competitor just ran a holiday shopping show, and budget radio talk is rising in the community.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN 2026-11-26 YouTube slot. This is not another deals list (we already did Black Friday deals). It is written for the non-ham spouse or kid doing the buying: picks by type of operator (shack, portable, brand new tech), from a $40-class antenna up to the $999 ID-5200 we own, plus a short 'what not to buy' section on CB and GMRS radios that look like ham gear. The earlier gift pitch was gear we tested; the new angle is the buyer's guide for non-hams.

ideas.title: Icom IC-7110 vs IC-7300MK2: Picking the Right Icom HF Rig for 2027
ideas.why_now: Both radios are the two most talked about Icom HF rigs this year, the IC-7110 price is now public, and HF radio discussion is up in the last 30 days. Holiday and year-end buyers are choosing between them right now.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN 2026-12-17 YouTube slot. New angle on a rig we have covered: not the filing or the price reveal, but a side-by-side buying decision for the everyday ham (who each radio is for, what the MK2 upgrade gets you, what the IC-7110 filing and price tell us). Be clear about what we have had hands on versus what is on paper.

ideas.title: Learning CW, Part Two: First CW Parks, Voyager 1 and a Winter Practice Plan
ideas.why_now: Morse code talk is surging in the community, the worldwide Morse event for Voyager 1 made the news, and winter is when people commit to finally learning code.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN 2026-12-03 podcast slot (record 2026-12-01). A follow-up to our strong learning CW episode: what happens after you learn the code (first CW-only park activation, slowing down for new ops, bugs vs paddles), the Voyager 1 Morse moment, and a simple winter practice plan. The earlier pitch was an app test of trainers; this is an operating and motivation conversation.

ideas.title: Wouxun Files Two New Radios With the FCC, One for GMRS #shorts
ideas.why_now: Two fresh Wouxun filings appeared at the FCC, one labeled GMRS, alongside a new Retevis filing. Handheld news and GMRS questions are doing very well as Shorts right now.
ideas.angle: A quick Short, released outside the long-form slots any day this week. Show the filings, explain that a filing is not a product yet, and what to watch for. Different from earlier pitches, which were about Icom's UHF digital filings.

ideas.title: VKVSkimmer on an RTL-SDR: A Free CW and RTTY Skimmer for Your Shack
ideas.why_now: SDR is the fastest rising topic in the community and CW is right behind it. A brand new free skimmer that works with a cheap RTL-SDR, SDRplay or an IC-7610 ties both together.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN 2026-12-31 YouTube slot. Set it up on a cheap RTL-SDR and on an Icom rig, show it decoding a whole CW band at once, and how it helps a new CW op find activity. Timely exception: SDR has too few of our own uploads to judge, so we lean on the software angle (Logging and Software is 1.44x for us) and the Icom name in the title. Earlier SDR pitches were browser decoders and MultiPSK; this is a skimmer, which is new.
